description: This file defines a Java class 'Log' that acts as a helper for logging purposes within an Android project. It provides static methods for various log levels (verbose, debug, info, warn, error, assert) and manages a linked list of LogNode objects to route log messages.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: A helper class providing static methods for logging at various levels, managing LogNode chaining, and defining log level constants.

methods.name: getLogNode
methods.description: Returns the current LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setLogNode
methods.description: Sets the LogNode to which log messages are sent.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Dispatches a log message to the current LogNode if set.

methods.name: v
methods.description: Logs a message at VERBOSE level with or without an exception.

methods.name: d
methods.description: Logs a message at DEBUG level with or without an exception.

methods.name: i
methods.description: Logs a message at INFO level with or without an exception.

methods.name: w
methods.description: Logs a message at WARN level with or without an exception.

methods.name: e
methods.description: Logs a message at ERROR level with or without an exception.

methods.name: wtf
methods.description: Logs a message at ASSERT level with or without an exception.
